_comment: Framework ids chosen from the prod `frameworks` run on 2026-09-24 (English editions). grade_from_code is used where education_levels is unusable: TX has none; GA stamps every item 09-12. GA science is not in the database, so it is left out. Set pdf.pages for GA math and NC math after `pdf-pages`.
